Scope update taken. New SHA:

  6532f49cf42095d988cf4d2029725bb515290d10

Every derived scalar now goes through Estimate.score (or finiteWeightedMean which ends in score). Scout's seven doors, named courts:

  Sum(Max,Max) / Mean(Max,Max) / Variance(Max,-Max) / Slope(Max,-Max)
  WeightedMean(1.0, weights Max,Max)
  scalar Gaussian(Max,Max) and kernelAt Gaussian(Max,Max)
  all Missing(NotFinite)
  Maximum(Max,Max) stays Observed(MaxValue) — the finite control

a190f17 was WeightedMean-only and is superseded.

GATE (archive, scalafmtCheckAll last, unpiped)
  featuresJVM/JS/Native 57/57
  GATE_EXIT=0

Please merge.
